title: darker gui and better ore's
description: This is my very first texture pack. I made sure the ores are more visible during mining, without completely changing the texture. The GUI is now black and transparent.
body: This is the first texture pack that i ever made. it has a darker trasparant gui and the ores are more visible. Budding amethyst has now a more visible cross and the full grown amethyst cluster have now little red exclamation marks on them.
